glossary.definition: (1) "Meetings of the implementing states" means meetings of the entire body of the states that are entitled to participate in discussions to finalize the agreement because they have enacted legislation based on the uniform sales and use tax administration act, approved January 24, 2001, or the simplified sales and use tax administration act, approved January 27, 2001.
glossary.source_title: Section 5740.02 - Simplified sales and use tax administration act definitions.

glossary.definition: (2) "Governing board" means the board that, under the terms of the agreement, is responsible for the administration and operation of the agreement.
glossary.source_title: Section 5740.02 - Simplified sales and use tax administration act definitions.
